review.reviewer: OpenCode agent, independent manual source review
review.method: Fetched the current Vercel Web Interface Guidelines, independently read exactly the 17 listed final source files, applied every relevant rule, and checked the approved redesign contract, semantics, focus, responsive behavior, image metadata, motion, content boundaries, and deferred minor findings. Scores and findings were authored from current source; qa.mjs only validates and consumes them.
review.scope: Exactly the 17 listed Astro page, layout, component, and CSS files in src/
